fact: In March 2022 the finance minister said taxpayers can file up to 49 electronic return forms under a unified tax registration number and pay electronically by non-cash means, with the core system live since January 2021 and 34% growth in non-cash collections.
title: وزير المالية.. في الاحتفال بنجاح المرحلتين الأولى والثانية لمنظومة الإجراءات الضريبية الموحدة المميكنة
